newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Clinton to visit Australia in November - tv.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Clinton to visit Australia in November - tv.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton is tentatively scheduled to visit Australia in late November, two weeks after the November 5 presidential election, Nine Network television reported on Thursday.
Clinton would arrive in Canberra on November 21 before spending time in Sydney and then the Great Barrier Reef in tropical Queensland, the network said.
In Canberra he was expected to address parliament.
On November 24 he would leave for the meeting of the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation forum in Manila.
"Sources say that only an escalation of the Iraq conflict would be likely to stymie the plans," the network reported.
A spokesman for Prime Minister John Howard said Clinton might visit.
"We are hopeful that the president could make a visit to Australia around the time of the APEC meeting but have no confirmation that that will in fact occur," the spokeman said.
An Australian foreign affairs source said he knew the visit had been considered.
"People have looked at it," the source said.
